scope: Apollo Block II DSKY Channel 010 latching-relay logical row/bit to physical D1-D6/K1-K20 package crosswalk.

signalFlow2005918.description: Original 2005918 AGC DSKY signal-flow drawing. Sheet 1 part 3 gives relay-word-code -> XDI selection-line table and relay-column truth table; sheet 1 parts 1-2 show OUT0/YDI/XDI drive network and physical relay matrix.

physicalPackageSignalCrosswalk.description: Previously proven D1-D6/K1-K20 -> XDI/YDI package drive-network mapping, joining original 2005954A interconnect labels to original 2005973 topology.

t4ruptProgram.fact: RELTAB packs relay-word code in the upper four OUT0 bits and relay code in the lower five bits; DSPLAY writes the combined word to OUT0.

pinball.fact: Documents relay-word binary codes and the two five-bit digit fields, independently corroborating the 2005918 code/column interpretation.

logicalStateDrivePolarity.zero: 1006282 figure / 2005918 note: relay winding on pads 1-5 corresponds to logical 0 / turns off; package crosswalk pad 1 direct YDI signal is therefore zeroDrive.
logicalStateDrivePolarity.one: 1006282 figure / 2005918 note: relay winding on pads 9-10 corresponds to logical 1 / turns on; package crosswalk pad 10 direct YDI signal is therefore oneDrive.

limitations: This crosswalk proves latching K1-K20 package identity for Channel 010 logical positions. It does not assign non-latching K21/K22 functions.
K21/K22 remain subject to production 2004689 pin/dash evidence and the documented K22 transcription conflict.
This is design-document plus Apollo 11 flight-software evidence, not a serial-number/as-flown relay manufacturing record.
